    AI integration

    AI, built into what you already use.

    You don't need to replace your software to use AI. We connect it to the tools, data and workflows you already have, so it works where your team works.

    We use AI agents in our own work every day, including to rebuild our own software.

    Talk to us about AI →
    • Assistants & agentsAnswer questions from your own documents and data.
    • AutomationHandle repetitive work like sorting files, drafting emails and building reports.
    • AI featuresAdded to your existing apps, sites and dashboards.
    • IntegrationConnected to the systems you already run, with your data kept private.
    Process

    How a project runs.

    The same six stages whether we're shipping a logo, inventing a filter or an app. You get one point of contact the whole way through.

    01

    Discover

    Calls, research and a clear brief. We find out what success looks like.

    1–2 wks
    02

    Define

    Scope, budget and a plan, with the risky parts named up front.

    1 wk
    03

    Design

    Concepts, iterations and decisions. You see work early and often.

    2–6 wks
    04

    Engineer

    Code or production files. Built to be made, not just shown.

    Varies
    05

    Build

    Prototypes, factory runs or releases. We manage vendors and QA.

    Varies
    06

    Launch

    On shelves, live online, in people's hands. Then we keep improving it.

    Ongoing
    The team

    We are a group of polymaths — artists, designers, developers, engineers and inventors — with a common passion for creative problem solving and innovative play.

    Small by design. You work with the people doing the work, never a rotating bench.
    We build our own products, so we know what shipping and supporting one feels like.
    A few projects at a time, each one given full attention.
